responsibility: Provides the baked ICU locale-fallback parent mapping payload for this data set, exposing a locale lookup that returns the single root (`und`) `LocaleFallbackParentsV1` record consumed by the generated provider implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-named files that either only declare submodules or serve other data keys, this is the leaf module for `LocaleFallbackParentsV1Marker`, providing the parent-locale mapping lookup and its single root `UND` record rather than likely-subtags, collation supplement, or list data.
